intervals.label: collaboration (HDMS operation)
intervals.note: Lower bound: the installation of the HDMS prototype at LNGS; the collaboration's founding date is not published. End: see the experiment record.
intervals.quote: The HDMS prototype was installed at LNGS in March 1998 and successfully took data over a period of about 15 month, until July 1999

intervals.label: completed (no end date published)
intervals.quote: The HDMS (Heidelberg Dark Matter Search) setup at LNGS, operates the first enriched {sup 73}Ge detector worldwide

name: HDMS Collaboration
notes: No roster or member count was found; the Atlas records no memberships. The Heidelberg-Moscow double-beta experiment (same group) is not recorded: it is primarily a neutrinoless double-beta decay experiment.

summary.plain: The Heidelberg team that built and ran HDMS, a pair of nested germanium crystals deep inside the Gran Sasso mountain in Italy, to search for dark matter particles.
summary.technical: Group of the Max-Planck-Institut fuer Kernphysik, Heidelberg (spokesman: H.V. Klapdor-Kleingrothaus), which also ran the Heidelberg-Moscow double-beta experiment and proposed GENIUS. Named only 'the Collaboration' in the 2002 HDMS paper ('* Spokesman of the Collaboration').
